verdict.rationale: Brave does offer AI-generated, sourced answers (docs-27, docs-17), but its own MCP server docs show this actually requires two calls — first a web search with summary:true, then a separate summarizer call using the returned key (docs-16/30) — contradicting a true 'single API call' flow. Community evidence also flags that the standard/free plan's ToS bars using responses for AI inference, requiring a separate AI Inference plan to legitimately consume the answer (comm-1, comm-2). missing for 10: a genuinely single-call summarized/grounded-answer endpoint, and confirmation that AI-answer use is permitted without a special plan.
